name: github-action-ai-code-reviewer
description: GitHub Action that reviews a pull request's Diff with an LLM and posts the result as a Review.

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
